name: Teeccino Dandelion Caramel Nut Herbal Tea (Chicory-Free)
whyItWorks: Specifically blended for sensitive stomachs and IBD patients who must avoid prebiotic chicory root inulin. Made with roasted dandelion root, carob, and natural nut flavors; entirely alkaline and non-acidic.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Brew in a standard coffee maker or steep tea bag in boiling water for 5 minutes. Stir in unsweetened oat or almond milk.
